tool_args.rationale: The archive suggests a nonlinear sink-coupled siphon baseline and a fast-minus-slow adaptation. Their additive combination is a distinct stationary candidate for the observed early positive response and later reversal. The previous attempt to test it failed at execution, not confirmation; fit its parameters numerically and submit it for fresh testing.

considered_alternatives.option: Previously submitted sink-coupled dual-timescale response and siphon plus slow adaptation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both were refuted on fresh confirmation; their exact source code is not present in the supplied history.
The available batches already supply 11 observations spanning short and long horizons; test the distinct additive mechanism before buying more data.
The observations jointly show a sink-dependent baseline and a slow horizon-dependent reversal, neither of which is adequately explained by those mechanisms alone.
